description: This file contains definitions of durable grain classes and interfaces for Orleans testing, including state management and methods for setting and retrieving state data.

classes.name: TestDurableGrainState
classes.description: Serializable record representing the state for TestDurableGrain.

classes.name: TestDurableGrain
classes.description: Durable grain implementing ITestDurableGrain for basic state management.

classes.name: TestDurableGrainWithComplexState
classes.description: Durable grain implementing ITestDurableGrainWithComplexState managing complex state objects.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name from the grain's state.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the counter value from the grain's state.

methods.name: SetTestValues
methods.description: Sets name and counter values in the state.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the unique activation identifier for the grain.

methods.name: GetPerson
methods.description: Retrieves the 'person' object from complex state.

methods.name: GetItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list items from complex state.

methods.name: SetTestValues
methods.description: Sets complex state values including person and list items.
